date_scope_check.qualification:
SA018-D1: This is an Indian legal-policy segment, not a demonstrated physical-gate interval or bilateral operating status. Announcement, implementing memo and customs-circulation dates differ. Nationality-specific passenger returns are separate; no later goods-policy confirmation is inferred from passenger advice.

SA018-C1: Endpoint is first restricted cargo exception. This operational segment overlaps the existing legal-policy segment and must not be summed with it. No ordinary reopening inferred.

SA018-AUDIT20261026-1: The April 24 implementing order supplies the policy onset. May 2026 reporting explicitly links the still-closed crossing to the post-Pahalgam closure; the fresh FCDO observation confirms ordinary tourist transit remains closed on the review date. The latter is a confirmation date, not a new onset. Nationality-specific returns, exceptional pilgrims, cargo and ceremony attendance are not ordinary tourist reopening. The August 2026 e-Visa-port designation is not evidence that the physical crossing reopened. The three overlapping scopes must not be summed.
